# Portable storefront migration

Read `AGENTS.md` and `MIGRATION.md` before starting work. Apply the committed skills in `.github/skills/`; if your Copilot host cannot invoke them by name, read the relevant `SKILL.md` files directly.

When the user supplies a source URL for migration, follow the reusable workflow in `MIGRATION.md`. Start discovery without asking for details that are observable from the site. Record every discovered URL, page component classification, implementation status, and blocker in the documented migration files so another agent can resume.

Do not assume the next source site is Boost Mobile. Do not copy another user's credentials, use demo services as production, or claim a local draft is published. Preserve unrelated work and keep local reports and drafts excluded from EDS delivery through `.hlxignore`.
